text: I am writing this letter to lodge a formal complaint concerning the substandard quality of the books I purchased from your store and the unprofessional attitude of your staff.
On October 25th, I ordered a set of reference books with Order Number 89214.
However, when the parcel arrived yesterday, I was shocked to find that the covers were torn and several key pages were missing.
Even more frustrating was that when I contacted your online customer representative for a reasonable explanation, my request was met with total indifference.
Such irresponsible conduct is completely unacceptable to long-term consumers.
Therefore, I deem it imperative that an immediate replacement or a full refund be arranged promptly.
Your swift attention and rectifying measures will be highly appreciated.
